tool.name: collection_input_paths
tool.description: prints the input and metadata file paths each accessor gives the tool, and checksums them
tool.command: #set $coll_metadata_files = [mf[1] for mfs in $input1.all_metadata_files for mf in mfs] #set $single_metadata_files = [mf[1] for mf in $single.all_metadata_files] echo 'FOR_LOOP:#for $e in $input1# $e#end for#' > '$out' && echo 'ALL_PATHS:#for $p in $input1.all_paths# $p#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_SERIALIZE_SOURCE:#for $s in $input1.serialize()# $s["source_path"]#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_ALL_METADATA_FILES:#for $mf in $coll_metadata_files# $mf#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_SERIALIZE_METADATA:#for $s in $input1.serialize()##for $m in $s["metadata_files"]# $m["source_path"]#end for##end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE: $single' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_ALL_METADATA_FILES:#for $mf in $single_metadata_files# $mf#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_SERIALIZE_SOURCE: ${single.serialize()["source_path"]}' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_SERIALIZE_METADATA:#for $m in $single.serialize()["metadata_files"]# $m["source_path"]#end for#' >> '$out' && ## Rendering a metadata file parameter makes Pulsar stage that file by itself. #if $metadata_params echo 'COLL_FOR_METADATA_PARAM:#for $e in $input1# $e.metadata.bam_index#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_METADATA_PARAM: $single.metadata.bam_index' >> '$out' && #end if echo "JOB_DIRECTORY: \$(pwd)" >> '$out' && ## A file missing at its path gets no CHECKSUM line. for f in #for $e in $input1#'$e' #end for#'$single' #for $mf in $coll_metadata_files + $single_metadata_files#'$mf' #end for#; do md5sum "\$f" | sed 's/^/CHECKSUM: /' >> '$out'; done && cp '$json_paths' '$json_out'
